events.text_en: Mạc Nhất Thoa finishes the Gate's staff canon, nine layers for the nine lines of the song the guides sing on the road.
The founder of Xuyên Lâm Môn dies of a centipede's venom in Xích Túc Cốc, guiding a salt caravan through; his first disciple Nhậm Bình Sinh takes the staff.

Nhậm Bình Sinh sits nine days in the rain without a hat at the gate of the Tower's new seat on Thần Cổ Phong, among the Gate's mines. He walks home and dies that winter, leaving the founder's staff to Úc Diệp Thanh and the founder's cape to Phí Thoa Y.
The Road Mother of Xuyên Lâm hides the Tower's deserter Nghiêm Quy Khứ in her house at Dẫn Lộ Thôn, and writes one letter up the mountain.
On the morning the isle rises at Hà Châu, the Gate's ferry warden Đinh Vãn Độ poles out to it and drives the Gate's staff into its mud.
